positions.title: Blockchain Developer
positions.description:
GSC Aviation is a company which aims to succeed in overcoming the challenges of the Aviation Industry. 

- SME wastes purchaser’s resources because of the inefficiencies in current processes, thus costing the enterprise money. Business development is difficult, with non relevant results and quality concern issues due to a lack of performance tracking regarding their suppliers. - Suppliers waste time auditing their customers financial strength, they could wait months to be paid, and the sourcing and reach out potential new customers is a long and expensive process. 

GSC IS GOING TO PROVIDE A SOLUTION FOR BOTH PURCHASERS AND SUPPLIERS TO REDUCE THEIR RISKS, IMPROVE THEIR PROCESSES AND DEVELOP THEIR BUSINESSES! Many tools of the GSC system will utilize the BLOCKCHAIN which will bring SECURITY, RELIABILITY, RELEVANCE and INSTANT INFORMATION.

• Website: https://www.gscplatform.io 

• Project: https://mro.gscplatform.io

• Exhibited at TechCrunch 2018 at San Francisco

• Top 20 Blockchain Startups listed for Founder World Championship 2018

• https://markets.businessinsider.com/news/stocks/top-20-blockchain-startups-announced-for-founder-world-championship-2018-1027507716

To use Solidity, Turffle, Ganache, infura, Geth, React JS, IPFS, Web3

positions.title: Hackathon Google Home Assistant App Winner
positions.description:
• Participated in AngelHack Hackathon (AH10) June 10, 2017 - June 11, 2017 at AWS Loft Manhattan. http://angelhack.com/angelhack-global-hackathon-series-manhattan 
• The winner of Google assistant app. Built a best app for the Google Assistant on Google Home, Android phones and the iPhone. Judge: Benjamin Dubow  
• Prize: one Google Home Device per team member. 
• Used Api.ai as frontend, Google cloud function (serverless api) as middleware, IBM loopback (strongLoop) as database and backend server, deployed on Bluemix.
